question:
**Consider the following statements about Khelo India Winter Games 2024:**

1.) Indian Army topped the medal tally with 10 golds.

2.) Jammu & Kashmir, former champions, finished second in 2024 with nine gold medals. Which of the following Statement is/are **Correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3 (Both 1 and 2 are correct)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1: Indian Army topped the medal tally with 10 golds**

 
 
• This statement is **correct**. The **Indian Army** emerged as the top-performing team in the **Khelo India Winter Games 2024**, securing the highest number of gold medals, which was **10 golds** in the overall tally.
 
• The Indian Army has consistently participated in various sports initiatives and its dominance in the Winter Games is a reflection of its focus on **physical fitness, discipline, and sports excellence**.
 
 
 
• **Statement 2: Jammu & Kashmir, former champions, finished second in 2024 with nine gold medals**
 
 
• This statement is also **correct**. The region of **Jammu & Kashmir**, which had won the overall championship in previous editions of the Winter Games, secured the **second position** in 2024 with **nine gold medals**.
 
• Jammu & Kashmir has been a prominent participant in winter sports, given its geographical advantage of snow-capped mountains and infrastructure for activities like skiing, ice skating, and snowboarding.
 
 
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games 2024** was organized to promote **winter sports** in India and nurture young talent in disciplines like skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, and other snow-based activities.
 
• The event fosters a competitive spirit among athletes from different parts of the country and serves as a platform for identifying talent for international competitions such as the Winter Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Winter Games Overview:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India Winter Games** is an initiative under the Government of India’s **Khelo India programme** to promote sports culture and identify talent in various sports disciplines.
 
• The winter edition of the games focuses on **snow-based sports** and is typically held in regions like **Jammu & Kashmir** and **Himachal Pradesh**.
 
• The games have been instrumental in encouraging participation from athletes in high-altitude regions and creating awareness about winter sports in India.
 
 
 
• **Notable Sports in Khelo India Winter Games:**
 
 
• **Skiing:** Events include slalom and giant slalom, requiring athletes to navigate a downhill course marked by gates.
 
• **Snowboarding:** A popular winter sport that involves descending a snow-covered slope while standing on a board.
 
• **Ice Hockey:** This team sport is played on ice and has gained traction in regions like Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh.
 
• **Figure Skating:** A sport where individuals or teams perform spins, jumps, and dance moves on ice.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Programme:**
 
 
• The **Khelo India programme** was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in **2018** to revive India’s sports culture at the grassroots level.
 
• It aims to identify and nurture young talent by providing scholarships, world-class training facilities, and exposure to international competitions.
 
• The programme includes **sports infrastructure development**, coaching support, and organizing national-level competitions.
 
 
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir’s Contribution to Winter Sports:**
 
 
• Jammu & Kashmir is home to popular tourist destinations like **Gulmarg**, which has become a hub for skiing and snowboarding in India.
 
• The region hosts training camps and competitions for athletes aspiring to represent India in **international winter sports events**.
 
• Infrastructure development and government support have significantly enhanced the participation of local athletes in national and international games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Medal Tally in Khelo India Winter Games 2024:**

 
 
• **Indian Army:** 10 gold medals, topped the tally.
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir:** 9 gold medals, secured second position.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Winter Sports:**
 
 
• Winter sports are gaining popularity in India, particularly in the Himalayan regions.
 
• These sports help in promoting tourism and creating job opportunities in high-altitude areas.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• The Khelo India Winter Games serve as a platform for identifying talent for **international events** like the **Winter Olympics**.
 
• Continued investment in infrastructure and training is essential for India’s success in winter sports on the global stage.
